snippet.title: Cursed to Golf - Official Introduction Trailer
snippet.description:
Cursed to Golf creator Liam Edwards introduces you to his unique creation - a game that mixes roguelike elements, Metroidvania, zaniness, lightheartedness, and of course golf. Some in the Itch.io community, where the game originated, have even called it "the Dark Souls of golf games." It will be out as a full-fledged game for PC and Nintendo Switch in January 2022.

#IGN #Gaming
